label: lives in
definition: Person or group X lives or has a residence in geographical place Y.
scope_notes: Preserves personal residence scope. Death, birth, work, visit or a relative residing somewhere is not sufficient. Dictionary contains substantial family and obituary contamination; do not broaden to all person-place association.
